limitations: Fixed-observation policy comparisons are not new simulated matches.
Near-zero movement and full-state freeze candidates do not establish their physical or engine cause.
No new overall rating screenshot was supplied.
Team results involve different opponents, teammates, maps and seats; no causal win-rate claim is made.

definitions.round_number: One-based in this report; public round_index is zero-based.
definitions.seconds: match_tick/60; own decisions normally every three ticks.
definitions.near_zero_xy_move: Live and alive at both ends of a 3-tick interval; previous applied XY move magnitude >0.1; recorded XY displacement <=0.005m. Sum of intervals, not one continuous episode.
definitions.state_freeze: Entire me dictionary unchanged for at least 3 seconds, despite at least one substantial applied turn request; candidate evidence, not confirmed platform root cause.
definitions.premature_patrol: Observed site-center goal switch across a 30-second timer bucket, while noncarrier and current bomb coordinates absent; previous goal more than 5m away. Conservative recorded-state detector.
definitions.reexecution: Same recorded observations in original order, one init per match; emitted V1 action compared with recorded action at rel/abs tolerance 1e-12. No new world simulation.
definitions.known_hidden_bomb: Alive live defender; current planted bomb position omitted, while same-round same-fuse position was legally observed earlier.
